heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of a shower, except slight chance in southeastern valleys. Highs in the low to mid 70s. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly to partly cloudy. Slight chance of an evening shower mainly northeast. Areas of valley fog. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Areas of valley fog early, then partly to mostly sunny. Highs from the mid 70s to around 80. Winds variable to southwest at around 5 mph.
